title: How to sync your FitBit, JawBone, or FatSecret with the Fast Track Patient Support Center
seoTitle: How to sync your FitBit, JawBone, or FatSecret with the Fast Track Patient Support Center
metaDescription: This short video shows you how to sync your FitBit, JawBone UP, or FatSecret account to our Patient Support Center.
excerpt: This short video shows you how to sync your FitBit, JawBone UP, or FatSecret account to our Patient Support Center.
author: DrCurry
bodyHtml: New sync capabilities enable our patients to use FitBit or JawBones to track their activity and diet very closely.  The information you enter into your FitBit app will automatically sync into the patient portal, which will help our dietitians keep you on track with your weight loss!  I have already lost almost 2 pounds in just 2 weeks with my FitBit, so I encourage folks to get one and join Curry Losers on the FitBit communities! Here is a 3 minute video on how to set it up, it’s easy! Don’t give me too much grief for my food diary…it was a little celebration! Happy losing, Dr. Curry If this video doesn’t work, click here for an alternate method to view it.
